promotions.behavior: Door state and traversal ordering are centralized in RuntimeDoorAccessService.
supportingEvidence: Existing living-world traversal blocks locked and closed doors.
Existing generated gate records classify door gates separately from trap and movement effects.
Smoke validation proves deterministic access-state-trap-movement ordering.
promotions.safeFallback: Missing or invalid door state denies traversal.
promotions.runtimeImpact: Door access now has an explicit deterministic coordinator.
promotions.characterSaveImpact: None; inventory consumption is returned as a request to the Character inventory owner.
promotions.worldStateImpact: Open, locked, broken, reset deadline, and revision may persist when configured.

promotions.behavior: Keys authorize lock and unlock requests, while inventory ownership and final consumption remain outside the door subsystem.
supportingEvidence: Door/key relationships are represented in existing room and exit catalogs.
Ownership separation avoids duplicating Character inventory mutation.
assumptions: A consumable key is consumed only after the inventory owner commits the returned request.
promotions.safeFallback: Missing, mismatched, or unowned keys deny state mutation.
promotions.runtimeImpact: Lock and unlock operations validate explicit key identity and ownership.
promotions.characterSaveImpact: Potential item decrement only after an external inventory transaction succeeds.
promotions.worldStateImpact: Successful authorization mutates door lock state.

promotions.behavior: Lockpick and bash are evidence-only authorization requests rather than invented native success formulas.
supportingEvidence: Commands and abilities can request these actions, but exact native probability and durability formulas remain unresolved.
assumptions: The ability owner resolves skill success before or after this policy request in final integration.
promotions.safeFallback: Deny unless the definition explicitly permits the action and the actor has the required ability marker.
promotions.worldStateImpact: Only an approved request mutates lock or broken state; marked evidence-only.
